messages:
elaine: Uploading the pen-test + vuln-scan artifacts for ACME's security/legal review. Putting everything in the shared bucket and attaching checksums. Need remediation owners + ETA by EOW so we can include in the client package. S3: s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567890/ :point_down:

mike_sec: Got it. Quick summary from me: 4 HIGH, 12 MED. The 4 highs are: exposed telemetry endpoint (auth bypass), outdated protobuf lib (RCE CVE), overly permissive CORS on api-stats, and leaked admin IPs in logs. I can draft remediation steps but need owners.

anna_platform: I can take the telemetry and CORS items. Will schedule a canary config push and a hotfix patch for headers. ETA: config change + canary by tomorrow noon PST, full rollout by Thurs EOD.

sam_sre: Please confirm artifacts + checksums. I will mirror to our internal evidence bucket and timestamp it. Also need the Qualys scan export (XML) unzipped for triage.

elaine: Uploads done. Links: s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567890/pen-test-2026-03-18.pdf, s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567890/qualys-2026-03-17.zip

Checksums (sha256):
```
pen-test-2026-03-18.pdf  3b1e9f8a6c3d4a2f5f9b7c8d7e6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8
qualys-2026-03-17.zip  d4c3b2a190f8e7d6c5b4a3928172635443322110ffeeddccbbaa998877665544
```

mike_sec: Thanks. Sam — mirror + timestamped copy please. Also: before we hand anything to the customer, we need a redacted pen-test that removes internal IPs and service account ARNs. Can someone take redaction?

anna_platform: I can scrub the logs and produce a redacted PDF. ETA: today 5pm PT. Will keep a redaction manifest.

audit-bot: Automated scan summary uploaded. High findings: 4, Medium: 12, Low: 29. Report ID: RB-ACME-2026-03-18. Link: https://audit.local/reports/RB-ACME-2026-03-18

sam_sre: Mirror done. Internal path: s3://rwinf-internal/audit_mirror/ACME/1934567890/sha256.txt. Verified checksums match.

elaine: @mike_sec, after redaction, can you sign off on the client package for legal? We should also add a short remediation timeline to the cover note.

mike_sec: Will review redacted PDF once anna uploads. For the remediation timeline to include in the customer packet:
- Telemetry auth fix: owner @anna_platform, patch + canary: 2026-03-19 12:00 PT, full rollout 2026-03-19 23:00 PT
- Protobuf lib update: owner @dev-team (requesting nominee) - PR + test by 2026-03-20, deploy 2026-03-22
- CORS tighten: owner @anna_platform, deploy 2026-03-19 14:00 PT
- Log redaction of admin IPs: owner @sam_sre, mask + replay test by 2026-03-20

elaine: I'll put that timeline into the cover note. Any blockers for sending to ACME security after redaction + signoff?

sam_sre: One ask — customer will likely want proof of fixes (diffs + deploy job IDs). We should capture CI artifacts and include a small evidence bundle (links to PRs, CI run IDs). I can gather those post-deploy.

anna_platform: Redacted PDF uploaded: s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567890/pen-test-2026-03-18-redacted.pdf. Redaction manifest: pen-test-redaction-manifest.txt (lists removed fields).

mike_sec: Reviewing now. A couple of notes inline: remove the debug snippet at appendix B (still contains stack traces referencing internal hostnames). I'll mark up in next message.

mike_sec: (inline notes) Appendix B: remove stack trace lines 12-18. Replace with "stack trace removed for internal detail". Also replace exact ADMIN_IP list with "redacted-IPs" placeholder.

anna_platform: Acknowledged. Pushing an updated redaction in 15m.

elaine: Once Mike signs off, I'll send the packet to ACME security + legal. We should cc: solutions-eng for any follow-up POC asks.

mike_sec: Signed off after the appendix and IP placeholder changes. :thumbsup: Please include the remediation timeline and PR links when you send.

elaine: Sending now to ACME security and legal. Outreach note: short summary + link to redacted report + remediation timeline + request for 1-week feedback window. Sending thread to customer at 2026-03-19 20:00 UTC.

sam_sre: Copy received. Will attach PR/CI evidence to this thread as items land.

elaine: Thanks team — great cross-functional turnaround. Will update sales opp with the package timestamp and next customer call date. :rocket:
